codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly reintroduces a runtime boundary for session bootstrap. The ISH_TASK_ZERO_ALLOW_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP flag is properly defined in ISHRuntimeFlags.h and TerminalViewController.m correctly allows session bootstrap functions (become_new_init_child, PTY creation, create_stdio, do_execve) while STILL BLOCKING task_start(current). This creates the smallest safe boundary immediately before guest runtime as specified.

summary: This feature successfully implements the session bootstrap boundary as specified.
